name: Zalando Partner (ZDS)
description: Zalando's partner APIs for Zalando Direct Ship merchants: orders, order items, shipments, returns, stock and price feeds. OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Partner onboarding required.
instructions:
**Partner onboarding required.** Zalando's merchant APIs are not open: you need an active Zalando Partner Programme contract and credentials issued through **Zalando zDirect**. There is no self-service signup and no public sandbox, so this adapter ships unverified by design.

**Setup**
1. In zDirect open the API section and create an OAuth 2.0 client for your merchant account. You receive a **client id** and **client secret**.
2. Note your **merchant id** — a UUID that scopes every path. Zalando merchants often have several (one per sales channel or country), and the wrong one returns an empty, entirely convincing result.
3. Set `ZALANDO_CLIENT_ID`, `ZALANDO_CLIENT_SECRET` and `ZALANDO_MERCHANT_ID`.

**Client credentials, scoped per API.** The token endpoint is `https://api.zalando.com/oauth2/token` and the scopes you were granted determine which of the paths below actually answer. A 403 here usually means a missing scope rather than a bad secret.

**ZDS vs Partner Fulfilment.** These tools target **Zalando Direct Ship**, where the merchant ships to the customer. Merchants on Zalando Fulfilment Solutions (ZFS) use a different set of endpoints for stock and shipping, because Zalando holds the inventory.

**Dates** are ISO 8601 with a zone. Order lists are cursor-paged: pass back the `next` token from the response rather than computing an offset.

**Unverified.** The paths and field names below follow the vendor's published documentation and have not been exercised against a live tenant. Treat a 404 as a docs-versus-reality gap and check the developer portal before concluding that the credential is wrong. A correction from anyone running this against a real system is genuinely welcome.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_orders
tools.description: List orders for the merchant with their order number, date, status and totals. Cursor-paged: pass back the `next` token from the previous response.

from.description: Earliest order date, ISO 8601 with a zone.

to.description: Latest order date, ISO 8601 with a zone.

status.description: Restrict by order status, e.g. OPEN, FULFILLED, CANCELLED.

next.description: Cursor token from the previous page.

tools.name: zalando_zds_get_order
tools.description: Read one order in full: its items with EAN and price, the delivery address, and the current fulfilment state of each item.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_order_items
tools.description: List the individual items of one order with their EAN, article number, price and per-item status — the level Zalando actually fulfils and cancels at.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments the merchant has reported, with their carrier, tracking number, date and the order items they cover.

from.description: Earliest shipment date, ISO 8601 with a zone.

next.description: Cursor token from the previous page.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_returns
tools.description: List returns with their EAN, reason code, date and the order they belong to — the input to any returns-rate analysis.

from.description: Earliest return date, ISO 8601 with a zone.

next.description: Cursor token from the previous page.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_stock
tools.description: Read the stock Zalando currently holds for the merchant's EANs, so a discrepancy with the ERP can be found before it becomes an oversell.

next.description: Cursor token from the previous page.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_prices
tools.description: Read the prices currently live on Zalando for the merchant's EANs, including any active promotional price and its validity window.

next.description: Cursor token from the previous page.
